content.text:
Branch `newsletter`, builds clean, filter verified in browser.

- [src/content.config.ts](src/content.config.ts) — `writing` collection: `title`, `description`, `date`, `labels[]`, `draft`
- [src/pages/writing/index.astro](src/pages/writing/index.astro) — list with label chips; clicking one filters, plus auto read-time
- [src/pages/writing/[...slug].astro](src/pages/writing/[...slug].astro) — post page in your existing card style
- [src/pages/rss.xml.js](src/pages/rss.xml.js) — feed (`@astrojs/rss` was already installed), "subscribe" link on the index
- [src/content/writing/hello.md](src/content/writing/hello.md) — sample post, doubles as the how-to-add-a-post doc

Skipped: label deep links (`?label=x`), pagination, email signup form. Add deep links when you want to share a filtered view; email signup when there's an actual list to send to — RSS covers the newsletter itch for now.

Heads up: the nav active-highlight compares `currentPath === "/writing"` but the URL is `/writing/`, so it never highlights — same pre-existing issue as `/services`. One-char fix if you want it.

Dev server running at http://localhost:4321 — it's open in the Browser pane.

- `/writing` — the new index
- `/writing/hello` — the sample post
- `/rss.xml` — feed

content.text:
The filter was already there — it just didn't look like one. Now: a `FILTER` row under the intro, chips on each post are clickable too, and an empty state when a label matches nothing. Verified in the browser (match shows, mismatch hides + empty line appears).

**Read time** — [index.astro:12](src/pages/writing/index.astro:12):

```
Math.max(1, Math.round(body.split(/\s+/).length / 200))
```

Raw markdown body (frontmatter excluded), split on whitespace, at 200 words/min, minimum 1. So markdown syntax like `##` and `-` counts as words — off by a bit on link-heavy posts, fine for a "~3 min" hint.
